import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: ['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating']
# index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: ['movie_id', 'title']
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source 0 and Source 1 on 'movie_id' to get 'title' for each rating
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='movie_id', how='inner')

# Now, we need to produce the target schema: ['title': string, 'size': integer, 'mean': float]
# 'size' = count of ratings per title
# 'mean' = average rating per title

# Group by 'title' to aggregate
df_agg = df_joined.groupby('title').agg(
    size=('rating', 'count'),
    mean=('rating', 'mean')
).reset_index()

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
df_agg['title'] = df_agg['title'].astype(str)
df_agg['size'] = df_agg['size'].astype(int)
df_agg['mean'] = df_agg['mean'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_agg.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_24_0 and Source2_24_1 on movie_id
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='movie_id', right_on='movie_id')

# Group by title, aggregate count of rating as size and mean of rating as mean
result = joined.groupby('title', as_index=False).agg(
    size=('rating', 'count'),
    mean=('rating', 'mean')
)

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
